## Projects

### Stock Market Analytics Dashboard
Tags: Power BI, Python, Data Analytics, Finance, SQL
Repository: https://github.com/Ansh-Patoliya/Stock-Market-Analytics-Dashboard

The Stock Market Analytics Dashboard is a comprehensive, interactive Power BI suite designed to analyze stock market behavior. Utilizing 5-minute OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) historical data, it computes and visualizes trend metrics, momentum indicators, volatility indices, and key candlestick statistical behaviors to empower traders and analysts with actionable market insights.
Key Objectives:
- Price Analysis: Track intraday trend cycles and micro-movements.
- Trend Detection: Highlight market directions using multi-interval Moving Averages and Cross-over markers.
- Momentum Monitoring: Gauge oversold and overbought conditions.
- Volatility Analysis: Quantify risk parameters using price deviations.
- Candlestick Statistics: Measure structural candle configurations (wicks, body proportions).
- Interactive Design: Deliver a modern dashboard optimized for performance.

### IPL Analytics Dashboard
Tags: Power BI, Data Analytics, EDA, SQL
Repository: https://github.com/Ansh-Patoliya/IPL-Dashboard

An interactive and dynamic Power BI Dashboard that provides comprehensive insights into Indian Premier League (IPL) matches, team performances, and player statistics across multiple seasons.
This dashboard is designed to analyze IPL historical data to help cricket enthusiasts, analysts, and franchise managers gain deep insights into match trends, player profiles, and team statistics.
The dashboard leverages Power Query for data transformation, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) for advanced calculations/measures, and modern Power BI visuals for interactive storytelling.

### AI Video & Voice Transcriber
Tags: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Gemini API, FFmpeg
Repository: https://github.com/Ansh-Patoliya/AiVideo_Voice_Trans

A web app that turns uploaded video or audio files, or links such as YouTube, into accurate timestamped transcripts.
An interactive studio keeps the transcript in sync with the video, supports inline editing and AI-generated summaries, and exports to SRT, PDF, DOCX, CSV and TXT.
Built with a React + TypeScript frontend, a FastAPI backend, the Google Gemini API for transcription, and FFmpeg and yt-dlp for media handling.

### OmniDoc AI
Tags: Python, Streamlit, Gemini API, ReportLab
Repository: https://github.com/Ansh-Patoliya/OmniDoc-AI

A Streamlit app that turns raw text, document photos, handwritten notes and diagrams into styled PDF reports.
Google Gemini handles text extraction, document structuring and automatic styling, ReportLab generates the PDF, and Mermaid flowcharts are rendered straight into the document.

### Mockly
Tags: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Gemini API
Repository: https://github.com/Mocktra-Forge/Mockly

An interview preparation platform where students practice role-specific questions and get personalized feedback.
Answers are scored with a hybrid method: keyword matching, semantic embeddings and LLM grading. It includes timed mock interviews, a gated 3-round placement simulation and a performance dashboard.
Built with React, Node.js + Express, MongoDB and the Google Gemini API.

### Stocxsim
Tags: Flask, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, SmartAPI, Plotly
Repository: https://github.com/Stocxsim/stocxsim

A web-based paper trading simulator that uses live NSE/BSE market data from Angel One SmartAPI.
Users can sign up, fund a virtual account, place simulated orders and track their portfolio without risking real money.

### Stocxsim 2.0
Tags: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, WebSockets

The second version of Stocxsim, rebuilt around dedicated services: an order-matching engine, a portfolio engine, a brokerage charge engine, watchlists, holdings and transaction history, all on top of live market data.

## Blog posts

### Syntra: a hackathon management platform
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/syntra-hackathon-management-platform
Date: 2026-10-14
Tags: Syntra, Hackathon, Web App

Running a hackathon means juggling registrations, teams and a crowd of people on event day. Syntra is a hackathon management platform that brings all of that into one place.

## What it does

- Participant console: participants sign in, register their team and follow the event from one dashboard.

- Team registration: a simple flow to form a team and sign up for the event.

- QR scanning for volunteers: on event day, volunteers scan a participant's QR code to check them in quickly instead of working through a spreadsheet.

## Who it is for

Organisers who want a smoother event, and participants who want a clear, simple experience.

### Stocxsim: practise trading without risking money
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/stocxsim-paper-trading-simulator
Date: 2026-10-11
Tags: Stocxsim, Stock Market, Web App

Stocxsim lets you learn how the stock market works without risking a rupee. You trade with virtual money, but the prices are real.

## What it does

- Sign up and fund a virtual account with practice money.

- Place simulated orders on stocks using live NSE/BSE market data.

- Track your portfolio and see how your decisions would have played out.

## Why it matters

Beginners often learn trading by losing money. A simulator with real prices lets you make mistakes safely and learn from them.

A second version, Stocxsim 2.0, adds watchlists, holdings, transaction history and brokerage charge calculation.

### Stock Market Analytics Dashboard: trend, momentum and volatility at a glance
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/stock-market-analytics-dashboard-overview
Date: 2026-10-08
Tags: Power BI, Stock Market, Data Analytics

This Power BI dashboard turns 5-minute OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) stock data into insights you can read quickly.

## What you can see

- Price analysis: intraday trends and small price movements.

- Trend detection: moving averages and crossover markers show market direction.

- Momentum: spot overbought and oversold conditions.

- Volatility: understand how risky the price movement is.

- Candlestick statistics: body and wick proportions of candles.

## Who it is for

Anyone who wants to understand market behaviour without reading raw tables.

### IPL Analytics Dashboard: the numbers behind the game
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/ipl-analytics-dashboard-overview
Date: 2026-10-04
Tags: Power BI, IPL, Data Analytics

The IPL Analytics Dashboard lets you explore the history of the Indian Premier League in one interactive report.

## What you can explore

- Match trends across multiple seasons

- Team performance: how teams have done over time

- Player statistics and profiles

## How it was made

Data was cleaned and shaped with Power Query, calculations were written in DAX, and the report uses interactive Power BI visuals so you can filter by season or team.

## Who it is for

Cricket fans, analysts and anyone curious about the numbers behind the game.

### AI Video & Voice Transcriber: from speech to editable text
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/ai-video-voice-transcriber-overview
Date: 2026-09-30
Tags: AI, Transcription, Web App

This web app turns spoken content into text, quickly and accurately.

## What it does

- Accepts uploaded video or audio files, or a link such as YouTube.

- Creates a timestamped transcript using Google Gemini.

- Syncs with the video: the transcript follows the video as it plays.

- Lets you edit the text inline.

- Generates AI summaries.

- Exports to SRT, PDF, DOCX, CSV and TXT.

## Where it helps

Lectures, interviews, meetings and subtitles.

### OmniDoc AI: from messy notes to a clean PDF
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/omnidoc-ai-notes-to-pdf
Date: 2026-09-25
Tags: AI, PDF, Productivity

OmniDoc AI takes whatever you have, a pasted paragraph, a photo of a page, handwritten notes or a diagram, and turns it into a neatly formatted PDF.

## What it does

- Reads text from documents and handwritten notes.

- Structures the content into clear sections.

- Styles it automatically.

- Draws diagrams: flowcharts are rendered straight into the document.

- Exports a ready-to-share PDF.

## Who it is for

Good for students turning rough notes into clean study material, or anyone who needs a tidy report from scattered inputs.

### Mockly: practise interviews, get real feedback
URL: https://ansh-patoliya.vercel.app/blog/mockly-interview-preparation-platform
Date: 2026-09-20
Tags: Mockly, Interview Prep, AI

Mockly helps students prepare for placements by practising, not just reading.

## What it does

- Role-specific questions to practise for the job you want.

- Personalised feedback: answers are scored with a mix of keyword matching, semantic similarity and AI grading.

- Timed mock interviews to practise under pressure.

- 3-round placement simulation that unlocks step by step.

- Performance dashboard to track your progress over time.

## Who it is for

Students who want to know where they stand before the real interview, and what to improve next.
